title: In all prior released versions of FRRouting, the OSPFv3 (for IPv6) implementation does not check that OSPFv3 packets…
description: FRRouting's OSPFv3 implementation in all prior released versions does not properly verify that OSPFv3 packets use a link-local source address and a link-local or multicast destination address. This flaw may allow remote IPv6 hosts to establish OSPFv3 adjacencies unexpectedly. Use of OSPFv3 authentication trailers mitigates full exploitation but may still allow CPU resource exhaustion through authentication checks.
